bagPolicy.summary: Only a single-compartment bag, clutch, wallet, fanny pack or clear bag smaller than 4 × 6 × 1.5 inches may enter. Medical and diaper bags smaller than 16 × 16 × 8 inches are exceptions and will be searched.
allowed: Medical or diaper bag smaller than 16 × 16 × 8 inches
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: On-site general parking is included with a concert ticket; consult the Pine Knob parking map for the entrance assigned to your ticket.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The Pine Knob A–Z guide does not give a universal rideshare pickup point.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Concessions serve beverages, and guests aged 21 or older may buy up to two alcoholic drinks per transaction with valid ID. Outside alcohol is prohibited.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: An accessible restroom is near stage-right concessions; the venue publishes a separate accessible-ticket and parking guide.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: There is no re-entry after leaving Pine Knob Music Theatre.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Will Call is at the Ally East Box Office. The venue also lists a UWM West Box Office and a box office next to the Trinity Health VIP entrance.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: All guests pass a walk-through detector or wand screening and may undergo a pat-down; medical and diaper bags are searched. Consult the show listing for the opening time.
